fullContentHtml:
DAV Staff Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for LDC, PGT, PRT and More Posts - Complete Details

The DAV College Managing Committee (DAVCMC) released the Recruitment 2026 notification for Teaching anf Non Teaching Posts. The online application opens on 16-09-2026, and closes on 08-10-2026. The candidate shall apply online through DAVCMC website, davcmc.net.in.

Important Dates

  • Last date to submit form as "Form Ready for Verification" : 08 October 2026
  • Datesheet preparation & exam centre preference : November 2026
  • Admit Card download : November 2026
  • CBT Exam : December 2026
  • All Candidates : Rs. 300/- (online payment only, on the DAV Recruitment website)

Application Fee

  • Post Categories : Teaching Posts & Ministerial/Non-Teaching Posts
  • Application Fee : Rs. 300/- (online payment)
  • Advertisement of vacant posts in newspapers : 16 to 22 September 2026
  • Online CBT Registration Form available : From 16 September 2026
  • Last date to submit form as "Form Ready for Verification" : 08 October 2026
  • Payment of CBT Fee : Within 7 days of being marked "Verified and Approved for Payment"

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
